verdict.rationale: Firebase's first-party Cloud Firestore docs have a dedicated page on K-nearest neighbor vector search, covering storing vector values and creating and managing KNN vector indexes. That delivers the core of the story: storing embeddings and running similarity search. The evidence is limited to a few short snippets from that one page, so details such as distance measures, query limits, embedding generation and AI-feature integration are not shown. Missing for 10: detail on distance measures and query options, embedding-generation integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
